name: safebyok-workspace
description: The safebyok workspace: the safebyok package, its companion packages under packages/, and the demos under demos/. Never published.
author: Philip (flip) Kromer <flip@mrflip.com>

scripts.lint: both() { pnpm lint:root; root=$?; pnpm -r --no-bail --stream lint "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.typecheck: both() { pnpm typecheck:root; root=$?; pnpm -r --no-bail --stream typecheck "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.test: both() { pnpm test:root; root=$?; pnpm -r --no-bail --stream test "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.test:coverage: both() { pnpm test:root; root=$?; pnpm -r --no-bail --stream test:coverage "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
scripts.justify:root: pnpm lint:root && pnpm typecheck:root && pnpm test:root
scripts.justify: both() { pnpm justify:root; root=$?; pnpm -r --no-bail --stream justify "$@"; exit $(( root || $? )); }; both
